what: research_catalog (src/runtime/research_catalog.py build_unit) reads results ONLY from research/results/<uid>/, so any unit whose lands.store is a corpus (docs/research/e35-bracket-corpus.jsonl, comms/macro/) reads `dispatched` with resultCount 0 for ever, even when its rows landed and were graded. MEASURED 2026-10-14: of 41 `dispatched` units, 27 e35-bracket units have corpus rows tagged research_unit=<uid> with sweep_generated_at >= their stamp (25 also carry a queue_grade verdict); RQ-20260928-023 (macro-valuation-backfill, lands comms/macro, no research_unit input) cannot be attributed at all. src/ runtime is outside the Tier-1 lane that found it. Fix: have the catalog count corpus rows keyed by research_unit (research_disposition.CORPORA already knows the stores) and treat a graded unit as `result`. Also: RQ-20260929-104 (funding_carry BNBUSDT, research-harness-dispatch) has 2 producer_failed rows ('build job concluded failure') and a third dispatch with no row; root cause of the build failure not diagnosed.
